text:
nina-partner: Hey folks — ingestion alert from Saturn: ~1.7% of yesterday's hourly device reports were rejected due to `entitlement_id` containing multiple IDs (delimiter `|`). Partner agent v2.3 batched device-level entitlements into a single line for efficiency. Sample attached.

mike-eng: can you paste the sample? curious if it's a single payload with multiple device_ids or one device with multiple entitlements.

nina-partner: sample below — they sent aggregated rows for a gateway that reported attached devices in one shot:
```json
{"gateway_id":"gw-77","timestamp":"2026-03-25T02:00:00Z","sku":"edge-lite","units":300,"entitlement_id":"ent-123|ent-124|ent-125"}
```

kevin-billing: our schema validator treats `entitlement_id` as a single token. When it sees a `|` we reject the row and currently drop it from the ledger flow — that explains missing usage in partner reports and a small balancing credit issued yesterday.

prashant-integrations: two ways to handle:
- immediate: ingest into a quarantine table and attempt an automated split: create separate provisional ledger rows per entitlement (units prorated or duplicated? needs business rule).
- better: ask partner to change agent to send per-device lines (one entitlement per row), but that's a client fix and will take time for older gateways.

mike-eng: my preference is quarantine + auto-split with clear audit flags. Proposed split rule: if units represent total attached devices count, and entitlement count equals number of attached devices, divide units evenly. If counts mismatch, mark as "ambiguous_split" and hold for partner mapping.

kevin-billing: billing constraints: provisional split entries should be marked non-final; do not trigger invoiceable tokens until partner confirms or backfill finishes. If partner requests immediate billing, we'll require a signed acceptance of the provisional counts.

sasha-ops: quick question — does this impact the co-marketing promo for NorthStar launch? we need a decision on proceeding with announcement.

nina-partner: this primarily affects one NorthStar pilot customer (~1 gateway cluster, ~600 devices) in NA. Partner team (cc @saturn-eng) says they can toggle agent to per-device mode for new reports in ~12h, but retro fixes need our help.

prashant-integrations: action plan (short):
- prashant: implement quarantine + split heuristic (ETA 4h)
- mike-eng: add flagging/metrics and an endpoint for partner to confirm mappings (ETA 12h)
- kevin-billing: prepare provisional ledger workflow and customer notice template (ETA 12h)
- nina-partner: ask Saturn to enable per-device mode for new data within 12h and produce mapping file for historical gateway clusters (ETA 24h)

marketplace-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-1499 -> entitlement-multiid-split-and-quarantine (severity: low-medium). Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-1499

sasha-ops: Given limited scope and partner patch ETA, I'm okay to proceed with NorthStar announcement provided we include a note re: minor usage timing differences and a 72h reconciliation SLA.

mike-eng: follow-ups:
1) quarantine accepted rows into `partner.quarantine_ent_multiid` with raw_payload, received_ts, original_units.
2) run auto-split heuristic and generate `provisional_ledger` records.
3) surface ambiguous rows to a manual reconcile queue with CSV export.

kevin-billing: agreed. We'll keep provisional ledger out of invoice generation and hold any automatic credits until manual verification. Reconciliation SLA proposed: 72h for pilots, 48h for GA customers.

nina-partner: partner uploaded mapping CSV at 2026-03-25T08:10Z listing gateway_id -> per-device entitlements. sending to you via secure upload.

prashant-integrations: implemented quarantine + auto-split PR -> merged to staging. added metric `unparsed_ent_multid` and alert >0.2% per-hour.

mike-eng: auto-split backfill job ran against the affected windows; ambiguous rows exported to reconcile queue (8 rows).

kevin-billing: provisional ledger generated for split rows; once mapping applied we will mark final and adjust invoice history where necessary. held credits reversed.

saturn-eng: patched agents: per-device mode enabled for affected clusters at 2026-03-25T10:45Z. new data arrives in correct format.

marketplace-bot: Update: incident #INC-2026-1499 status -> monitoring.

prashant-integrations: backfill complete; reconciled using partner CSV mapping; ambiguous rows reviewed and resolved with partner PM. added test vectors to PARTNERSHIP-MET-2026 epic.

kevin-billing: adjustments applied; final invoice reflect corrected usage. customer notified per SLA.

sasha-ops: good work. leaving note for marketing: include a brief line about reconciliation timeline and contact for invoice questions. proceeding with NorthStar announcement.

nina-partner: thanks everyone. closing the loop — will follow up if any regression. :raised_hands:
